courses.title: Web Design & Development
courses.description: Learn modern web design and development, from semantic HTML5 and responsive CSS to interactive modern JavaScript and complete web application deployment.
topics: Modern CSS: Flexbox, Grid Systems & Responsive UI
JavaScript Programming: ES6+, DOM & Event Engines
Asynchronous APIs, Fetch & Dynamic Web Applications
learningObjectives: Design intuitive, responsive user interfaces across mobile and desktop devices
Write accessible, standards-compliant HTML5 and modern CSS layouts
Develop interactive web applications utilizing modern JavaScript
Deploy and manage live student web applications using Git workflows
requirements: Basic computer literacy and a code editor (VS Code recommended)
Passion for web design and building modern software
courses.certificateInfo: Verified ARX Landscape Certificate awarded upon publication and review of a capstone web application.

courses.title: Python
courses.description: Learn Python programming from fundamentals to real-world applications, covering data structures, object-oriented concepts, automation scripting, and algorithmic problem-solving.
topics: Decision Making & Control Flow Loops (for, while, range)
Core Data Structures: Lists, Dictionaries, Sets & Tuples
File Handling, Automation Scripts & Algorithmic Projects
learningObjectives: Write clean, idiomatic Python code adhering to PEP 8 standards
Select and leverage appropriate data structures for problem solving
Automate repetitive computational tasks with custom scripts
Build and demonstrate a functional Python capstone project
requirements: Python 3 installed on your workstation (or use Computer Lab 3)
courses.certificateInfo: Verified ARX Landscape Certificate awarded upon submission of a functional Python project.

courses.title: Cybersecurity
courses.description: Master practical cybersecurity fundamentals, covering network defense, cryptography, threat modeling, ethical security principles, and system hardening.
topics: Computer Networking Basics (IP, TCP/UDP, DNS, Firewalls)
Common Threats, Malware & Social Engineering Defense
Ethical Security Rules & Practical System Hardening
learningObjectives: Identify common cyber threats and apply mitigation techniques
Analyze fundamental networking protocols and network defenses
Understand cryptography basics and secure authentication protocols
Adopt safe digital hygiene and ethical security research practices
requirements: Basic familiarity with operating systems and networking concepts
Ethical commitment to protective security standards
courses.certificateInfo: Verified ARX Landscape Certificate awarded upon completion of the security defense simulation.

courses.title: Robotics
courses.description: Learn the fundamentals of robotics, including electronics, sensors, microcontroller programming, automation, motor control, and hands-on robotics projects.
topics: Hands-on Capstone Robot Build & Autonomous Navigation
learningObjectives: Understand electronic circuit schematics and breadboard prototyping
Program microcontrollers to read sensor inputs and actuate motors
Implement autonomous algorithms for obstacle avoidance and line following
Assemble and test a physical working robot in the lab
requirements: Curiosity for hardware and hands-on laboratory tinkering
Hardware kits available in Computer Lab 3 during club hours
courses.certificateInfo: Verified ARX Landscape Certificate awarded upon successful robot demonstration.
